content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Kansas City

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour minimums based on your academic background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you document and confirm eligibility before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP training course. Attend all sessions to earn your required contact hours. Our Kansas City-based instructors deliver real-world examples and interactive instruction aligned to PMI's exam content framework.

steps_items.heading: Submit Application & Exam Fee
steps_items.text: Apply directly to PMI through their credential portal and pay the associated exam fee. Granite PM Academy provides guidance on the application process. Once PMI approves your application, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare & Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice exams, and study guides to build confidence. Schedule your computer-based exam at a nearby testing center. Our instructors remain available to clarify concepts and answer final questions before test day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) across the three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing courses, webinars, and resources to help you meet PMI's maintenance requirements without interruption.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?
fq_items.answer: No. All of our PMP training is delivered live-virtual via video conference, so {city} professionals attend from wherever they work. No commuting or hotel required.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
